FN-KHJZX5U-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 465
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Troy Stubbs
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/07/2025
House Bill 465 as introduced would codify the current practice of allowing the director of the
Alabama Emergency Management Agency to use funds appropriated to the agency to purchase
items to support the functions of the department, including public educational materials on
emergency preparedness.

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 465
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Troy Stubbs
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/22/2025
House Bill 465 as passed the House of Representatives would codify the current practice of
allowing the director of the Alabama Emergency Management Agency to use funds appropriated
to the agency to purchase items to support the functions of the department, including public
educational materials on emergency preparedness.
